background: HSBC Bank plc is the non-ring-fenced UK bank of HSBC, housing the group's European corporate and investment banking, markets and private banking, funded by corporate and institutional deposits and wholesale markets.
synthesis: All three main agencies rate the bank, AA- on average with the weakest at A+, two on a positive outlook and one on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026 and a move to positive outlook by one on 18 Sep 2026. CET1 of 16.9% is in the top quarter of UK majors, but leverage of 4.0% and NSFR of 113% are in the bottom quarter and LCR of 139% is below the median. Since 30 Sep 2025 CET1 has fallen 2.0 points, leverage 0.9 points and LCR 13 points (figures to 30 Sep 2026).
